periods.time: After Nango's three-day rearguard fight in Europe

name.zh: 爱德怀斯小莉南乡突入塔特拉基地
name.en: Edelweiss, Xiaoli and Nango Raid the Tatra Base

periods.summary: Wounded from days of delaying PSYON, Nango is found by Edelweiss and Fu Xiaoli. Edelweiss has traced the missing Tyrant corpse from Rebellion's throne room, while Xiaoli follows her to repay a life debt after being rescued from an alpine blizzard. The three Desperado-class fighters attack the base to confirm the Tyrant's location, battling multiple Abraham clones and finally reaching the hangar where the frozen body is stored.
periods.cause: Nango wants to identify where the US took the Tyrant's corpse; Edelweiss independently investigates the same danger before the corpse can ignite another world war.
periods.process: Nango explains the PSYON clone threat and asks the younger fighters for help. Xiaoli accepts because Edelweiss is her benefactor, and Edelweiss is already committed to Ryoma's will. They break out of Nango's sound concealment, fight teleporting and psychokinetic Abrahams, suffer wounds, and use Xiaoli's copied dragon fire to melt through the final steel wall.
periods.outcome: They reach the hangar containing the frozen Tyrant's body and appear to corner Arlanz, but the situation is actually a trap.
periods.significance: Brings the Ryoma-linked strongest fighters into the final arc's Tyrant mystery and sets up the revelation that Blutsauger has already been stolen.
